title: Inference cost at fixed capability falls ~100×/year

Open-model price analysis (LessWrong) [open-price] challenges this (frozen proprietary list prices inflate it; open models 7–28×)

title: Price declines are fastest at the capability frontier

title: Frontier capacity stays scarce until ~2027–28

relationships: Mixture of Experts [moe] supports this (idea in 1991/2017, value from a decade of fixes)

relationships: RLVR coverage study [rlvr-study] challenges this (sharpens sampling, narrows coverage)
